question: On 5–6 February 2025, the national executive council meetings of FICCI and CII converged at BGBS in which city?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kolkata**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The national executive council meetings of the two most prominent industry bodies in India, **FICCI** and **CII**, converged in **Kolkata** on **5–6 February 2025**.
 
• This historic convergence took place during the **7th edition** of the **Bengal Global Business Summit (BGBS)**, which is the flagship investment summit of the **Government of West Bengal**. ***Hence, the statement regarding the location is correct.***
 
• For the first time, both the **Federation of Indian Chambers of Commerce and Industry (FICCI)** and the **Confederation of Indian Industry (CII)** held their national leadership meetings simultaneously in the same city to support a state-level investment drive.
 
• The primary objective of this gathering was to discuss investment opportunities, industrial growth, and the economic potential of **West Bengal** and **Eastern India**.
